title: Classes page hides periods that don't run today, and spreading a day-view stack now actually shrinks the class column
summary: The Classes page used to always show every class regardless of the day's schedule -- an Advisory card stayed visible even on a Short Day with no Advisory period. It now hides any class whose period has no time under today's schedule type (and hides a whole category if none of its classes are scheduled today), matching the same rule Home's widgets and the Calendar already used.

Spreading open an overlapping event stack in Day view claimed extra width for its own cards, but the class column next to it never actually got narrower to make room -- it does now, and shrinks back the moment the stack collapses again. This also fixes a bug where an unrelated re-render (an external calendar feed finishing its refresh, a window resize, etc.) could silently snap a spread-open stack's layout back to its collapsed width.
